points: 14 of your 30 ads open on the same Shopify ban line, so merchants who were never banned scroll past. Run three new angles from your product, like frozen funds and approval speed, each with its own opening line.
The same Shopify ban copy runs in 14 of your 30 ads, so buyers who see one get the same message again. Keep the body, but change the opening line and the creative in each version to stop the repeats.

0 of 30 ads carry a proof number, so a new merchant has no figure to weigh your claims against. Collect one number, such as a count of merchants live or payments processed, and open three new ads with it.
0 of 30 ads carry an offer, though your site runs free shipping and percent off, so a new buyer has no reason to act today. Put free shipping on a first order into line one of three new ads.
